text:
L7CHECK_SERVER_DATA
Description
This iRule event is triggered each time new ingress data is received
from server.
Examples
when
L7CHECK_SERVER_DATA
{
# Set the L7 protocol using command L7CHECK::protocol set
L7CHECK
::
protocol
set
"smtps"
}
